task.description:
Reported by the owner 2026-11-06 after archiving tickets from benchwork: the ledger records a status change on archive, but GB-179 decided archived is a STATE, not a status.

DIAGNOSIS - data is intact, the vocabulary is not. Measured on this workspace: 286 tasks, 0 of them with status='archived', and 128 with archived_at set. Archived tasks hold the status they earned (7 ready, 2 triage, 119 verified). So the projection is already doing the right thing: it reads StatusChanged{to: Archived} as 'stamp archived_at, keep the status'. Nothing is corrupted today.

But that is a special case in the replayer standing in for a missing event. Two latent hazards. (1) A consumer reading raw ledger events sees a status transition to a variant the model says is never a status, which is exactly what confused the owner. (2) Any replayer that does not know the special case - a new tool, a rewrite, a backfill - would materialise status='archived' with no archived_at, or fold those rows into status counts, which is the same class of bug as GB-211.

Same shape on the other side: unarchive emits StatusChanged{from: verified, to: verified} when the status never moved, purely to clear the state.

FIX SHAPE: add TaskArchived and TaskUnarchived to LedgerEvent (contracts), carrying the status that was in force; emit them from archive_task/unarchive_task; teach the projection to set and clear archived_at from them; keep reading the legacy StatusChanged{to: archived} shim indefinitely, because 128 historical events already exist and a replay must reproduce today's state exactly. The compiler will name every exhaustive match on LedgerEvent.

ACCEPTANCE: a fresh replay of the existing ledgers yields byte-identical state (0 rows with status='archived', 128 with archived_at); a new archive records TaskArchived and no StatusChanged; and a test asserts the legacy event still replays to the same state.
task.title: Archive emits a status change to a status that no longer exists, so the ledger's vocabulary contradicts GB-179

receipt.summary: Fixed in contracts d1197f5 and storypole 0bcf3b3. Archive emitted StatusChanged{to: Archived} - a transition to a variant GB-179 says is never a status - and unarchive emitted StatusChanged{from: verified, to: verified}, a transition that moved nothing. Both now emit TaskArchived (carrying the status the task keeps) and TaskUnarchived. The legacy StatusChanged{to: Archived} arm stays in the replayer forever, because 128 such events already exist. Verified by deleting the index and rebuilding it from the ledgers through the new code: archived 128/128 delta 0, verified 106, ready 12, deferred 26, triage 11, blocked 4, index and ledger agree, and zero rows with status='archived'. Tier 2 fmt/clippy clean, nextest 51/51. OUTSTANDING: no unit test yet pins the archive/unarchive round trip - verified by full replay only.

acceptance_criteria: Unit test in storypole-core/tests/archive_and_lease_tests.rs (storypole 1590f95): 4 tests covering archive state
expired-claim reaping and a live claim being left alone; workspace nextest 55/55.
